picks.title: Gospel | Chapter 7: Dec 14, 1882 (Part 5) | Swami Sarvapriyananda
picks.summary: Swami Sarvapriyananda reads and discusses the Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna. The Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna is an English translation of the Bengali spiritual text Sri Sri Ramakrishna Kathamrita by Swami Nikhilananda. The text records conversations of Ramakrishna with his disciples, devotees and visitors, recorded by Mahendranath Gupta, who wrote the book under the pseudonym of "M."This session was recorded on Jan 24, 2023.🙏 Please Support the Vedanta Society of New Yorkhttp://www.vedantany.org/donate🌐 Please Visit UsWebsite: https://vedantany.orgApple & Spotify Podcasts: https://www.vedantany.org/
picks.reason: Discussion of Ramakrishna's Gospel revealing Hindu devotional and spiritual insights.

picks.title: Living Abundance Sedona Retreat Preview
picks.summary: What if abundance begins when we stop assuming everything is running out? In this short bonus episode of The Vedic Worldview Podcast, Thom previews his upcoming Living Abundance retreat in Sedona and explores why certainty has to be internalized rather than extracted from an ever-changing world. He reflects on unboundedness, spiritual evolution, and a deeper view of the Self as the basis for happiness and success. Listen to or watch this brief invitation to discover what Thom will be teaching from January 3 to 8, 2027. Find out more about the LIVING ABUNDANCE Wisdom Retreat here: https://thomk
picks.reason: Discusses abundance and Self from a Vedic perspective on spiritual evolution.
